title: Link two hubs
intro: Link this fleet's hub to another fleet's hub, so sessions on both sides can message each other. Each hub keeps its own hosts, devices and data.

steps.title: Other hub
steps.intro: The hub to link to. This hub dials it, so it needs an https address this hub can reach.

steps.title: Link code
steps.intro: Its operator runs fleet-hub pair --mode peer on that hub and sends you the code it prints. The code works once and expires in minutes; linking needs nobody on that side after it.
